method: Features with PLN_AREA_N == 'QUEENSTOWN' from the MP2019 subzone layer (columns SUBZONE_N, SUBZONE_C, PLN_AREA_N, PLN_AREA_C, REGION_N), Z dropped, made valid, transformed to EPSG:3414; area_m2 computed in SVY21.
purpose: Queenstown subzone polygons; join keys to Census 2020 subzone tables (age-sex-2020.json).
